Ordering table maps each part number to one CWDM center wavelength; shared specs apply to all 18 variants. Generic `SO-SFP-155M-L160D-Cxx` and `TSF037-CxxC-SO` have no separate ordering row, so they are not separate modes. No penalties were supplied. `SFP MSA` and `SFF-8472` both apply to every variant; the schema allows one `host_interface_name` per mode—`SFP MSA` is used (MSA compliance row).
